# A genuine Android key attestation chain, leaf first, base64 DER.
# Captured from a retail Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (SM-S918U, dm3q),
# Android 15, build S918USQU6DYD9, security patch 2025-04-01, by
# xkey-android AttestationCaptureTest.captureRealAttestationChain.
#
# challenge:     xkey-fixture-challenge
# securityLevel: strongbox (attestation and keymint both StrongBox)
# rootOfTrust:   deviceLocked=true, verifiedBootState=0 (verified)
# appId:         com.automatethethings.xkey.capture v1 (debug build installed
#                beside the owner's .debug package, so the capture
#                test's identity reset could not touch it)
#
# The first real-hardware fixture: its TEE-enforced authorization list
# carries Origin (tag 702) and Purpose (tag 1) as Keymint writes them,
# and the chain anchors at an embedded Google hardware attestation root.
